class.name: PacketCPP
class.brief_description: Encodes and decodes the simcall wire frame exchanged with the kernel driver over TCP.
class.description: Wraps one [code]simcall_header_t[/code] (24 bytes, little-endian / native byte order, version 4) plus its variable-length data payload. Every message between the Godot host and the in-VM kernel driver is a [PacketCPP]: the header carries the command, the peripheral type, the simulation timestamp, and the payload length; the payload carries either a [code]CMD_SYNCH[/code] device-registration body or a [code]CMD_ACTION[/code] dev_id + action payload. The HDWI resources build outbound packets internally and emit the raw bytes through [signal HDWIResource.on_send], so most GDScript only [i]decodes[/i] inbound frames with this class. [b]Decode an inbound header[/b] [codeblock] var pkt = PacketCPP.new() pkt.generate_from_bytes(first_24_bytes) # read PacketCPP.get_header_len() bytes first if not pkt.get_validity(): push_error("bad header (wrong version or size)") return HDWIResource.set_sim_time_ns(pkt.get_time_ns()) # keep the sim clock seeded var payload_len = pkt.get_data_len() # now read this many more bytes [/codeblock] [b]Build an outbound packet[/b] [codeblock] var pkt = PacketCPP.new() pkt.generate(PacketCPP.CMD_ACTION, PacketCPP.SPI, HDWIResource.get_sim_time_ns(), payload) socket.put_data(pkt.convert_to_bytes()) [/codeblock] [b]Debugging[/b] - set [member robust] (or call [method to_string_robust]) to get a sectioned, byte-offset-labeled dump that decodes the header and interprets the data section by command type.

method.name: generate
method.description: Fills the header (version 4, [param cmd_type], [param hdwi_type], [param time_ns]) and adopts [param bytes] as the payload, setting [code]data_len[/code] to its size. Pair with [method convert_to_bytes] to get the frame to send.

method.name: generate_from_bytes
method.description: Parses exactly [method get_header_len] bytes into the header. Marks the packet valid only when the version matches 4 and the input length equals the header size; check [method get_validity] afterwards.

method.name: convert_to_bytes
method.description: Serializes header + payload into a single contiguous byte buffer ready to write to the socket.

method.name: get_validity
method.description: Whether the last [method generate_from_bytes] produced a well-formed header (correct version and length).

method.name: get_cmd_id
method.description: The command id from the header ([code]CMD_SYNCH[/code] = 1, [code]CMD_ACTION[/code] = 2). See the [enum CmdType] constants.

method.name: get_type
method.description: The peripheral type from the header. See the [enum HDWIType] constants.

method.name: get_time_ns
method.description: The simulation timestamp (nanoseconds) carried in the header.

method.name: get_data_len
method.description: Length in bytes of the payload that follows the header. After decoding a header, read this many more bytes from the stream to get the body.

method.name: get_header_len
method.description: Size of [code]simcall_header_t[/code] in bytes (24). Use this as the fixed-size prefix to read before the variable-length payload.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Replaces the payload and updates the header's [code]data_len[/code] to match.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the current payload bytes (excluding the header).

method.name: to_string_robust
method.description: Returns the sectioned, byte-offset-labeled debug dump regardless of the [member robust] flag. Decodes the header and interprets the data section: [code]CMD_SYNCH[/code] as group registration, [code]CMD_ACTION[/code] as dev_id + payload.

members.member: When [code]true[/code], converting the packet to a string (e.g. [code]print(pkt)[/code]) emits the verbose [method to_string_robust] dump instead of the compact one-line form.

constants.constant: Time-seeding / device-registration command. Its payload is the concatenated group bodies; no per-device handshake (D050).
Peripheral I/O command. Its payload is a type-sized dev_id followed by the action payload.
